36 個問題，打開親密的入口

36 Questions That Bring Two People Closer
一場關於彼此內心世界的對話練習
A conversation guide for deeper connection
輕觸　開始這場對話
有些人相識多年，依然有一段距離；有些人，只因幾次真誠的交流，就開始感覺彼此靠近。心理學認為，親密感來自分享，也來自被理解。
Some people spend years together and still feel distant. Others grow closer through just a few meaningful conversations. Psychology suggests that intimacy grows through sharing and feeling understood.
這些不用急著一次完成！一場好的對話，就是靠近彼此的開始。
There is no need to rush. Perhaps every close relationship begins with one good conversation.
讓我們開始吧。
Let's begin.
01
一
Part 1 — Getting to Know Each Other

第一階段
慢慢打開自己

from light questions, building a sense of safety
從輕鬆的問題開始，建立安全感。
02
Part 1 · 01 — 03
1
如果可以邀請世界上任何一個人共進晚餐，你會邀請誰？
If you could invite anyone in the world to dinner, who would it be?
2
你想成為名人嗎？如果想，你希望用什麼方式被大家認識？
Would you like to be famous? In what way?
3
在打電話前，你會先想好要說什麼嗎？為什麼？
Before making a phone call, do you ever rehearse what you are going to say? Why?
03
Part 1 · 04 — 06
4
對你來說，一個完美的一天會是什麼樣子？
What would constitute a "perfect" day for you?
5
你上一次唱歌給自己聽是什麼時候？唱給別人聽呢？
When did you last sing to yourself? To someone else?
6
如果你可以活到 90 歲，並且保有 30 歲的身體或心智其中之一，你會選哪一個？
If you could live to age 90 and retain either the mind or body of a 30-year-old, which would you choose?
04
Part 1 · 07 — 09
7
你是否曾經祕密地覺得自己會以某種方式死去？
Do you have a secret intuition about how you will die?
8
說出三件你和對方可能共有的事情。
Name three things you and your partner appear to have in common.
9
你人生中最感激的是什麼？
For what in your life do you feel most grateful?
05
Part 1 · 10 — 12
10
如果可以改變你童年成長的一件事，你會改變什麼？
If you could change anything about the way you were raised, what would it be?
11
花四分鐘告訴對方你的人生故事。
Take four minutes and tell your partner your life story in as much detail as possible.
12
如果明天醒來，你獲得一種能力，你希望是什麼？
If you could wake up tomorrow having gained any one ability, what would it be?
06
二
Part 2 — Opening Deeper Conversations

第二階段
分享內心世界

talking about values, memory, and feeling
開始談價值觀、記憶與情感。
07
Part 2 · 13 — 15
13
如果一個水晶球可以告訴你任何關於未來的事情，你想知道什麼？
If a crystal ball could tell you the truth about anything, what would you want to know?
14
有沒有一件事情，你一直夢想去做？為什麼還沒做？
Is there something you've dreamed of doing for a long time? Why haven't you done it?
15
你人生最大的成就是什麼？
What is the greatest accomplishment of your life?
08
Part 2 · 16 — 18
16
友情中，你最珍惜的是什麼？
What do you value most in a friendship?
17
你最珍貴的一段回憶是什麼？
What is your most treasured memory?
18
你最糟糕的一段回憶是什麼？
What is your most terrible memory?
09
Part 2 · 19 — 21
19
如果知道一年後會突然離世，你會改變現在的生活方式嗎？
If you knew that in one year you would die suddenly, would you change anything about the way you are living now?
20
友情對你來說代表什麼？
What does friendship mean to you?
21
愛與感情在你的生命中扮演什麼角色？
What roles do love and affection play in your life?
10
Part 2 · 22 — 24
22
輪流分享五個你認為對方的優點。
Alternate sharing something you consider a positive characteristic of your partner.
23
你的家庭關係親近嗎？你覺得自己的童年比大多數人幸福嗎？
How close and warm is your family? Do you feel your childhood was happier than most people's?
24
你和母親的關係如何？
How do you feel about your relationship with your mother?
11
三
Part 3 — Creating Emotional Closeness

第三階段
建立更深連結

on vulnerability, trust, and being truly seen
談脆弱、信任與真正的自己。
12
Part 3 · 25 — 27
25
輪流分享三件，屬於「我們」的共同點。
Name three things that describe the two of you right now.
26
完成這句話：「我希望有一個人可以分享……」
Complete this sentence: "I wish I had someone with whom I could share…"
27
如果你們要成為親密朋友，你覺得對方需要知道什麼？
If you were going to become close friends, what would be important for them to know?
13
Part 3 · 28 — 30
28
告訴對方你喜歡他的地方，要非常誠實。
Tell your partner what you like about them; be very honest.
29
分享一個讓你尷尬的時刻。
Share an embarrassing moment in your life.
30
你上一次在別人面前哭是什麼時候？
When did you last cry in front of another person?
14
Part 3 · 31 — 33
31
告訴對方，你現在已經喜歡他的哪些地方。
Tell your partner something you already like about them.
32
什麼事情太嚴肅，不適合拿來開玩笑？
What, if anything, is too serious to be joked about?
33
如果今晚離開人世，沒有機會再聯絡任何人，你最遺憾沒有告訴誰什麼？
If you were to die tonight, what would you most regret not having told someone?
15
Part 3 · 34 — 36
34
你的房子著火了，救出所有人和寵物後，你還有時間拿最後一件東西，你會拿什麼？為什麼？
Your house catches fire. After saving loved ones and pets, you have time to save one item. What would it be?
35
在你的家人中，誰的死亡會讓你最難過？為什麼？
Of all the people in your family, whose death would you find most disturbing? Why?
36
分享一個你現在遇到的問題，問對方如果是你，他會怎麼處理。
Share a personal problem and ask your partner how they would handle it.
16
一個好的問題
可能就是靠近一個人的開始
A good question can become the beginning of a deeper connection.
36 Questions 讓兩個人慢慢靠近
Inspired by psychological research on intimacy

17
